name: Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Mochida Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals and healthcare products in Japan. The company offers pharmaceuticals products for the treatment of cardiovascular, obstetrics, gynecology, dermatologists, psychiatry, and gastroenterological, including Realda and Collagen for the treatment of ulcerative colitis; Goofis and Movicol for the treatment of chronic constipation; interstitial pulmonary hypertension for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension; Treprospermid, for pulmonary hypertension associated with ulcerative lung disease; Uris, for gout and hyperuricemia; and Clorox, for ulcerative colitis; Epadel for hyperlipidemia and obstructive arteriosclerosis; …
